description: This file contains business logic related to processing refunds within an e-commerce Django project. It defines a data class for refund request results and a function to handle refund requests by order reference code.

classes.name: RefundRequestResult
classes.description: A data class representing the outcome of a refund request, including success status, message, and optionally the associated order.

methods.name: RefundRequestResult request_refund(*, ref_code: str, message: str, email: str)
methods.description: Handles the process of requesting a refund by ref_code, updating order status, creating a refund record, and returning the result.

ctags.name: request_refund
ctags.pattern: /^def request_refund(*, ref_code: str, message: str, email: str) -> RefundRequestResult:$/
ctags.signature: (*, ref_code: str, message: str, email: str)
